declared_after: All 64 random DEV pilot attacks; exploratory followup, before fullDEV optimized attacks
purpose: Targeted evaluation stress test, not generation, cryptography, anonymization or SOTA. Attack explicitly sees target captions on DEV. No TEST.
sampling: All519 PHOENIX DEV and all1650 How2Sign released DEV. No TEST files downloaded for these studies.
gauge: alpha=exp(0.35*tanh(u)), beta=exp(0.35*tanh(v)), gamma=0.35*tanh(w). a_new=alpha*a, b_new=beta*b+gamma*a. Same canonical rotations mathematically. Padding untouched.
objective: Teacher forced cross entropy in fixed released reader. Network weights frozen. No decoder checkpoint selection. Output after exactly80 updates.
evaluation: raw reader decoded BLEU/chrF/ROUGE vs target and actual reference
limits: White-box target captions explicitly used, not generation
Two dataset-specific weights from same reader architecture, not two independent model families
No meshes rendered, full canonical rotations checked against official conversion
Canonical gate is a standard normalization, not a new math primitive
pipeline_contract: Original left hand canonicalized to reproduce native sample-dump loader unflip. Gauge attack allowed on body and right hand only (25 joints); left hand unchanged. Native sample loader checked on first8 clips including flip/unflip, for original and both targeted attacks.
